item.title: Judge grants Ole Miss QB Trinidad Chambliss a preliminary injunction for extra eligibility
item.description: In saying “the NCAA ignored its own rules,” a Mississippi judge granted Ole Miss quarterback Trinidad Chambliss a preliminary injunction Thursday against college athletics’ governing body, allowing him to receive an extra year of eligibility so he can play next season.

item.description: The amendment was approved Thursday without public hearings and amid concerns from opponents.

item.title: Michigander Hellebuyck backstops US to Olympics-opening win over Latvia 5-1
item.description: Bouncing back from having a pair of goals wiped out by coach’s challenges, the U.S. opened the Olympics by rolling past Latvia 5-1 on Thursday night in a dominant showcase of some of the country’s best NHL players. Brock Nelson scored twice, four players had two assists apiece and there was production up and down the lineup.

item.description: Sometimes, as the songs go, love stinks, love bites and love hurts.

item.title: Justin Verlander explains how he set Tigers homecoming in motion
item.description: Justin Verlander picked up the phone months before the Tigers ever offered him a contract. More than two decades after his Detroit debut, Verlander is back where his career began. This reunion was not accidental. As early as last November, he reached out to owner Chris Ilitch, president Scott Harris and manager A.J. Hinch to make clear he wanted to return.

item.title: Woods-Tower rallies past Clawson in OT, captures outright MAC Silver crown
item.description: With a series of events that took more twists and turns than a Rocky Mountain road, Warren Woods-Tower rallied back in overtime to earn a 41-38 over Clawson on Thursday night.
